The pool will stop accepting mining shares, which represent a miner’s contributions in the pool, on the cutoff date, according to SBI Crypto. Shares submitted after that cutoff will not be accepted, and the firm said the pool is expected to operate normally until the shutdown date. The company urged customers to keep mining with the pool until the cutoff so eligible shares are included in the final payout calculation.
